source_review_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review repaired database adjudication and final review from paper-local XML/PDF/OA package, Tables 1/3/4, figure/result sections, and linked DBAASP rows. Remaining cautions are nonblocking and preserved in final review_report.json. Numeric formatting-only database differences (1 versus 1.0 µM) were resolved as source-verified equivalence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No linked_sequence_records were present; Table 1 primary-source peptide labels and D-substitution markup were used for sequence/modification adjudication.
DBAASP linked assay rows are source-verified where present, but the snapshot omits some primary MIC rows for K22D and L12D/L20D.
The database and Table 4 use the same B. subtilis ATCC label; methods prose contains a different B. subtilis strain label, so final records retain Table 4 locators.
Packet raw files, OA package member list, supplementary_index, and supplementary_text/table outputs contain no supplementary files for this paper.
Retained mechanism claims are limited to membrane interaction/damage and structure-activity relationship evidence.
